answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake that vests only after weeks of useful work, like a willow that must root before it shades anyone. A fresh identity starts hollow, with no history to borrow, so an attacker must fund and babysit each clone separately while peers watch for copied work. A raven that spots a duplicate triggers slashing, burning the stake, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand bonds and the farm pays before it earns anything.
